data_fields.name: crit_chance_percent
data_fields.donor_constant: per attack power (value not read here)

best_idea: Resolve one hit as: accuracy against avoidance with a clamped miss chance, per-type resist, a percent-clamped armour absorb, then one crit or overhit multiplier and a rounding step, and apply the hp change in one place.
decision_why: The clamps and the crit-as-percent-of-post-armour step fit duel step row 1 and give designers clear data fields, but the donor's rand() rolls, its default-zero miss damage and its shields and death path inside takeDamage do not fit server-verified kills with one ledger.
acceptance: A server test asserts that armour never removes more than its configured max percent of a hit (except the 1-point minimum), that a crit on a post-armour 10-point hit deals 20, and that the same seed gives the same damage on server and client.
